anchors.description: Height of the white-framed glass patio door, from the bottom rail at the floor to the top door frame header, measured along the door plane.
anchors.visible_evidence: White-framed glass exterior door at left-center with its bottom rail meeting the interior floor and a white header/top frame visible above the brightest glass; both endpoints lie on the same door plane.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US exterior door is 80 in (2.03 m); a taller 84 in (2.13 m) custom door is possible, and the header is near the bright overexposed area so the top edge has a few pixels of slack.

anchors.description: Dining table height, from the tabletop surface at the near-right corner down to the floor at the base of the near-right table leg.
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark wood dining table fills the center of the room; its near-right leg descends from the tabletop corner to the tile floor, and floor tiles are visible around the leg base.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard dining table height is 29-30 in (0.74-0.76 m); a counter-height variant (~0.9 m) is unlikely given the paired standard dining chairs, but leg-base visibility is limited.

anchors.description: Seat height of the near-left dark wood dining chair, from the top of the blue seat cushion to the tile floor under the chair.
anchors.visible_evidence: Dark wood dining chair at the near-left side with a clearly visible blue-green seat cushion; its legs stand on the light tile floor, which is visible beneath the chair front.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard dining chair seat height is 17-18 in (0.43-0.46 m) with cushion thickness adding a few cm; the floor point is slightly forward of the seat edge, which can inflate the 3D distance a little.
